{{For|information regarding '''Traps''' such as {{tile|Bear}}|Traps}}
The battlefield in Mewgenics is made up of a 10×10 grid of '''Tiles''' for the player's party and their enemies to move and fight upon. Tiles can affect the units that stand on/move through them in a variety of ways, both good and bad, and as such are often crucial for defining the shape and flow of the game's many battles. 

They can either appear naturally as part of the pre-defined layouts for each battle, or they can be dynamically created/altered by both the player's party and their enemies through various abilities and/or the [[Elements]] system.

For all the ways tiles can be manipulated, see: [[List of tile change effects]].

Unless indicated otherwise, {{St|Flying}} units are generally exempt from the effects of standing on tiles.

__toc__

== Grass ==
Grass is one of the most common tiles types, first encountered in the {{ch|The Alley}}. 

{| class="wikitable" style= "width: 100%"
! style= "width: 100px" | Name !! style= "width: 130px" | Image !! style= "width: 420px" | Interactions !! Effects
|- id="Grass Tile"
! Grass Tile {{anchor|Grass Tiles|}}
| [[File:Grass Tile Icon.svg|120x120px|center]]
|
* Is a {{el|Grass}} element tile.
* When affected by {{Element|Fire}}, will turn into a {{tile|Fire}}.
* When affected by {{Element|Water}}, will grow into a {{tile|Tall Grass}}.
* When affected by {{Element|Ice}}, will turn into a {{tile|Ice Shards}}. 
| ''N/A''
|- id="Tall Grass Tile"
! Tall Grass Tile {{anchor|Tall Grass Tiles|}}
| [[File:Tall Grass Tile Icon.svg|120x120px|center]]
|
* Is a {{el|Grass}} element tile.
* When affected by {{Element|Fire}}, will turn into a {{tile|Fire}}.
* When affected by {{Element|Wind}} or {{Element|Gravity}}, will turn into a {{tile|Grass}}.
* When affected by {{Element|Ice}}, will turn into a {{tile|Big Ice Shards}}.
* Will combine with {{tile|Flower|Flowers}}, turning into a {{tile|Tall Flower}}.
|
* Units standing in Tall Grass have {{stat|Dodge Chance|#=+50%}}.
* Can affect {{St|Flying}} units.
|}

== Flower ==
Flower tiles are rarely found naturally outside of {{ch|The Rift}}, and are most often created by passive skills like {{p|Flower Power}}, spells such as {{a|Flower Feet}}, or items such as {{i|Flower Mix}}.

* Will usually spawn in encounters with {{Mb|Arthur}}.

{| class="wikitable" style= "width: 100%"
! style= "width: 100px" | Name !! style= "width: 130px" | Image !! style= "width: 420px" | Interactions !! Effects
|- id="Flower Tile"
! Flower Tile {{anchor|Flower Tiles|}}
| [[File:Flower Tile Icon.svg|120x120px|center]]
|
* Is a {{el|Grass}} element tile.
* When affected by {{Element|Fire}}, will turn into a {{tile|Fire}}.
* When affected by {{Element|Water}}, will grow into a {{tile|Tall Flower}}.
* When affected by {{Element|Ice}}, will turn into a {{tile|Ice Shards}}. 
|
* Units standing on flowers gain {{stat|Health Regen|+2}} and {{stat|Mana Regen|+2}}.
|- id="Tall Flower Tile"
! Tall Flower Tile {{anchor|Tall Flower Tiles|}}
| [[File:Tall Flower Tile Icon.svg|120x120px|center]]
|
* Is a {{el|Grass}} element tile.
* When affected by {{Element|Fire}}, will turn into a {{tile|Fire}}.
* When affected by {{Element|Wind}} or {{Element|Gravity}}, will turn into a {{tile|Flower}}.
* When affected by {{Element|Ice}}, will turn into a {{tile|Big Ice Shards}}.
|
* Units standing in Tall Flowers gain {{stat|Health Regen|+3}}, {{stat|Mana Regen|+3}}, and {{stat|Dodge Chance|50%}} <!--Not Statuses--> 
* Can affect {{St|Flying}} units.
* Counts as {{tile|Tall Grass}} for some item and ability effects such as {{i|Survivalist's Gaiter}}.
|}

== Bramble ==
Bramble tiles are most often found in the {{Chapter|The Crater}}. However, they can also be created by various spells (mostly {{element|Grass}} spells), such as {{a|Bramble Burst}} or {{a|Bramble Shot}}.

{| class="wikitable" style= "width: 100%" 
! style= "width: 100px" | Name !! style= "width: 130px" | Image !! style= "width: 420px" | Interactions !! Effects
|- id="Bramble Tile"
! Bramble Tile {{anchor|Bramble Tiles|}}
| [[File:Bramble Tile Icon.svg|120x120px|center]]
|
* Is a {{el|Grass}} element tile.
* When affected by {{Element|Fire}}, will turn into a {{tile|Fire}}.
* When affected by {{Element|Water}}, will grow into a {{tile|Thick Bramble}}.
* When affected by {{Element|Ice}}, will turn into a {{tile|Ice Shards}}. 
|
* Units take 2 damage each time they enter a Bramble tile.
* Moving through Brambles costs 2 movement.
|- id="Thick Bramble Tile"
! Thick Bramble Tile {{anchor|Thick Bramble Tiles|}}
| [[File:Thick_Bramble_Tile_Icon.svg|120x120px|center]]
|
* Is a {{el|Grass}} element tile.
* When affected by {{Element|Fire}}, will turn into a {{tile|Fire}}.
* When affected by {{Element|Ice}}, will turn into a {{tile|Big Ice Shards}}.
|
* Units take 4 damage upon entering a Thick Bramble tile.
* Moving through Thick Brambles costs 3 movement.
|}

== Water ==
Water is a somewhat-prevalent tile type, most commonly found in the {{chapter|The Sewers}}. 

Creep is found in large amounts in {{chapter|The Junkyard}}, and occasionaly in other chapters.

* {{tile|Supercooled Water}} can only exist during {{we|Snow}} or {{we|Blizzard}} weather. It can naturally spawn in the {{chapter|Ice Age}}.
* In {{ch|Throbbing Domain}} and {{ch|The End}}, water has a bloody-red coloration instead.

{| class="wikitable" style= "width: 100%"
! style= "width: 100px" | Name !! style= "width: 130px" | Image !! style= "width: 420px" | Interactions !! Effects 
|- id="Water Tile"
! Water Tile{{anchor|Water Tiles|}}
| [[File:TILE Water Icon.svg|120x120px|center]]
|
* Is a {{el|Water}} element tile.
* When affected by {{Element|Ice}}, will turn into an {{tile|Ice}}.
* When affected by {{Element|Wind}}, will turn into a {{tile|Water Current}}.
** The direction of the current matches the direction of the wind that created it.
* Conducts {{Element|Electric|Electricity}}.
|
* Makes units in it {{st|Wet}}.
* Costs 2 movement to walk through.
|- id="Water Current Tile"
! Water Current Tile {{anchor|Water Current Tiles|}}
| [[File:TILE Water Curren Icon.svg|120x120px|center]]
|
* Is a {{el|Water}} element tile.
* When affected by {{Element|Ice}}, will turn into an {{tile|Ice}}.
* Conducts {{Element|Electric|Electricity}}.
|
* Makes units in it {{st|Wet}}.
* Costs 2 movement to walk through.
* Units standing in it at the end of the round will be pushed in the direction of the current, into adjacent [[liquid tile|liquid tiles]] (will not be pushed outside).
|- id="Supercooled Water Tile"
! Supercooled Water Tile {{anchor|Supercooled Water Tiles|}}
| [[File:TILE Supercooled Water Icon.svg|120x120px|center]]
|
* Is a {{el|Water}} element tile.
* Becomes a normal {{tile|Water}} if not in an {{el|Ice}} environment.
* When affected by {{el|Ice}}, {{el|Wind}} or when a unit makes contact, will turn into an {{tile|Ice}}.
* Conducts {{Element|Electric|Electricity}}.
|
* {{st|Freeze|Freezes}} units that walk through it.
* Costs 2 movement to walk through.
|}

== Creep ==
Creep is found in large amounts in {{chapter|The Junkyard}}, and occasionally in other chapters.
* Although it isn't technically Water tile, some enemies and abilities will consider it as such due to its innate {{el|Water}} element.

{| class="wikitable" style= "width: 100%"
! style= "width: 100px" | Name !! style= "width: 130px" | Image !! style= "width: 420px" | Interactions !! Effects 
|- id="Creep Tile"
! Creep Tile {{anchor|Creep Tiles|}}
| [[File:TILE Creep Icon.svg|120x120px|center]]
|
* Is a {{el|Water}} element tile.
* Conducts {{Element|Electric|Electricity}}.
|
* Makes units in it {{st|Wet}}.
* Units take 1 damage either when first entering creep or starting their turn in creep.
** Walking between adjacent Creep will not inflict damage again.
* Costs 2 movement to walk through.
|}

== Dirt ==
Dirt is an uncommon tile type that rarely spawns naturally. 
* '''All''' {{element|Earth}}-element effects create Dirt on the tiles they target, replacing any non earth-element tile in the process. 
* {{mb|Mama Maggot}} always starts on a 2-by-2 square of Dirt tiles, while {{mb|Rat King}} always starts in a Dirt area.
{| class="wikitable" style= "width: 100%"

|- id="Dirt Tile"
! Dirt Tile {{anchor|Dirt Tiles|}}
| [[File:TILE Dirt Icon.svg|120x120px|center]]
|
* Is an {{el|Earth}} element tile.
* When affected by {{element|Wind}}, gives units standing on it {{st|Blind|#=1}}, then disappears.
|
|}

== Ice ==
Ice Tiles spawn naturally in the {{ch|Ice Age}}.
* Can be created through interactions with the {{element|Ice}} element. 
{| class="wikitable" style= "width: 100%"
! style= "width: 100px" | Name !! style= "width: 130px" | Image !! style= "width: 420px" | Interactions !! Effects 
|- id="Ice Tile"
! Ice Tile {{anchor|Ice Tiles|}}
| [[File:TILE Ice Icon.svg|120x120px|center]]
|
* Has the {{el|Ice}} element.
* When affected by {{Element|Fire}}, will turn into a {{tile|Water}}.
|
* Units that receive physical attacks on this tile will slide in the opposite direction until they either collide with something (dealing contact damage) or run out of ice tiles.
* Removes {{st|Wet}} from units that step on this.
* Units on this tile that are affected by non-persistent {{el|Water}} will {{st|Freeze}}.
|- id="Ice Shards Tile"
! Ice Shards Tile {{anchor|Ice Shards Tiles|}}
| [[File:TILE Ice Shards Icon.svg|120x120px|center]]
|
* Has the {{el|Ice}} element.
* When affected by {{element|Fire}}, will turn into a {{tile|Water}}.
|
* Units walking through this take 1 Damage.
* Removes {{st|Wet}} from units that step on this.
* Units on this tile that are affected by non-persistent {{el|Water}} will {{st|Freeze}}.
|- id="Big Ice Shards Tile"
! Big Ice Shards Tile {{anchor|Big Ice Shards Tiles|}}
| [[File:TILE Big Ice Shards Icon.svg|120x120px|center]]
|
* Has the {{el|Ice}} element.
* When affected by {{element|Fire}}, will turn into a {{tile|Water}}.
|
* Units walking through this take 2 Damage.
* Removes {{st|Wet}} from units that step on this.
* Units on this tile that are affected by non-persistent {{el|Water}} will {{st|Freeze}}.
|}
* {{bug|Ice tile will convert effects that cause negative knockback into 1 positive, impacting abilities that push back the caster such as {{a|Rebound}}, pushing the caster forward instead.}}

== Fire ==
Fire tiles are not ''naturally'' common, but can be easily created by using {{element|Fire}}-element damage or abilities on {{element|Grass}}-themed tiles (such as {{tile|Grass|Grass}}, {{tile|Flower|Flowers}}, and {{tile|Bramble|Brambles}}). 
* Can spawn naturally in some battles in {{chapter|The Core}}.
{| class="wikitable" style= "width: 100%"
! style= "width: 100px" | Name !! style= "width: 130px" | Image !! style= "width: 420px" | Interactions !! Effects 
|- id="Fire Tile"
! Fire Tile {{anchor|Fire Tiles|}}
| [[File:Fire Tile Icon.svg|120x120px|center]]
|
* Has the {{el|Fire}} element.
* When affected by {{Element|Water}}, will be extinguished, reverting to an {{tile|Empty}}.
* When affected by {{Element|Wind}}, will spread to an adjacent tile in the direction the wind came from, and will have its self-extinguishing timer reset.
|
* Will inflict {{St|Burn|#=1}} on anything that walks through it.
* Will inflict {{st|Burn|#=2}} on anything that starts their turn on this tile.
* Can affect {{St|Flying}} units in it's large and medium intensity.
* Shrinks in size after each round, disappearing after 3 rounds.
* Will spread and ignite adjacent flammable tiles at the end of each round.
|}

== Stalagmite ==
Exclusively found in the {{chapter|The Caves}}.
{| class="wikitable" style= "width: 100%"
! style= "width: 100px" | Name !! style= "width: 130px" | Image !! style= "width: 420px" | Interactions !! Effects 
|- id="Stalagmite Tile"
! Stalagmite Tile {{anchor|Stalagmite Tiles|}}
| [[File:Stalagmite Tile Icon.svg|120x120px|center]]
|
* Cannot be overwritten by {{el|Earth}}-element abilities creating dirt.
* Applying {{el|Earth}} element immediately drops a stalactite.
* {{en|Mega Fetus}} counterattack guarantees stalactites to fall on hit tiles, with a 50% chance on ajacent tiles.
|
* Chance for a stalactite to fall on this at the end of the round, dealing damage to units it lands on.
** Deals 4 environmental damage. <!--Not Phys/Mag. Undodgeable-->
** {{stat|Luck}} decrease the chance.
|}

== Glass ==
Glass Tiles, also known as '''glass shards''', are most commonly found in the {{chapter|The Junkyard}}.
* Regular Glass can be created by various enemies and glass-themed items/abilities, like {{i|Bag o' Glass}} or {{a|Shards}}.
* Floating Glass is typically the result of {{element|Gravity}} magic, such as {{a|Shatter the Sky}}.
{| class="wikitable" style= "width: 100%"
! style= "width: 100px" | Name !! style= "width: 130px" | Image !! style= "width: 420px" | Interactions !! Effects 
|- id="Glass Tile"
! Glass Tile {{anchor|Glass Tiles|}}
| [[File:Glass Tile Icon.svg|120x120px|center]]
|
* When attacked by {{icon|physical damage}}, breaks and inflicts {{St|Bleed|#=1}} to the unit on the tile.
|
* Units walking through this take 1 damage.
|- id="Floating Glass Tile"
! Floating Glass Tile {{anchor|Floating Glass Tiles|}}
| [[File:Floating Glass Tile Icon.svg|120x120px|center]]
|
* When attacked by {{icon|physical damage}}, breaks and inflicts {{St|Bleed|#=1}} to the unit on the tile.
* When affected by {{Element|Gravity}}, will turn into a {{tile|Glass}}.
|
* Units walking through this take 2 damage and gain {{St|Bleed|#=+1}}, then tile becomes a regular {{tile|Glass}}.
** Units moving ''involuntarily'' through this (i.e. those affected by Knockback) have their movement halted.
** Can damage {{st|Flying}} units.
|}

== Toxic Waste ==
A fairly rare tile type only found in the {{chapter|The Bunker}}.
* Can be created by {{i|Mini Nuke}}.
{| class="wikitable" style= "width: 100%"
! style= "width: 100px" | Name !! style= "width: 130px" | Image !! style= "width: 420px" | Interactions !! Effects 
|- id="Toxic Waste"
! Toxic Waste {{anchor|Toxic Waste Tiles|}}{{anchor|Toxic Waste Tile|}}<br><code>ToxicTile</code>
| [[File:TILE Toxic Waste Icon.svg|120x120px|center]]
|
* Applies {{el|Mutate}} element to units that step in it, evolving certain units ({{en|Maggot}} / {{en|Cultist Lackey}} / {{en|Cultist Zealot}}.
|
* Units who enter it or start their their turn in it gain 2 random stat increases or decreases for the duration of the battle.
** Each of the 2 stat changes is a {{stat|Luck}} roll of 50% to be a stat increase.
|}

== Lava ==
Most commonly found in {{chapter|The Core}}.
{| class="wikitable" style= "width: 100%"
! style= "width: 100px" | Name !! style= "width: 130px" | Image !! style= "width: 420px" | Interactions !! Effects 
|- id="Lava Tile"
! Lava Tile {{anchor|Lava Tiles|}}
| [[File:TILE Lava Icon.svg|120x120px|center]]
|
* Has the {{el|Fire}} element.
* Cannot be overwritten by {{el|Earth}}-element abilities creating dirt.
* When affected by {{el|Water}} or {{el|Ice}}, it will become a {{tile|Basalt}}.
** Also changes when next to a {{tile|Water}}.
* When affected by {{Element|Wind}}, will spread {{tile|Fire}} to flammable and empty tiles in the direction the wind blows.
|
* Costs 2 movement to walk through.
* Will inflict {{St|Burn|#=4}} on anything that walks through it.
* Will inflict {{st|Burn|#=4}} on anything that starts their turn on this tile. 
* Will ignite adjacent flammable tiles at the end of each round.
|}

== Tar ==
Most commonly found in {{chapter|The Jurassic}}.
* Can be created by {{en|Tar Baby}}
{| class="wikitable" style= "width: 100%"
! style= "width: 100px" | Name !! style= "width: 130px" | Image !! style= "width: 420px" | Interactions !! Effects

| [[File:TILE Tar Icon.svg|120x120px|center]]
|Will turn into a {{tile|Fire|Fire Tile}} when exposed to {{el|Fire}}.
| 
* Costs 2 movement to walk through.
* Inflicts units that walk through it with {{St|Tarred}}.
* Units hit with [[Knockback]] will slide until they hit an object or reach the edge of the tiles. 
|}

== Glitch ==
A rare tile exclusive to {{ch|The Rift}}.
* Created during the {{b|Chaos!}} fight on the same tile a {{b|Small Steven}} was killed.
* Can be created by {{en|Chaos Stacy}}.
{| class="wikitable" style= "width: 100%"
! style= "width: 100px" | Name !! style= "width: 130px" | Image !! style= "width: 420px" | Interactions !! Effects 
|- id="Glitch Tile"
! Glitch Tile {{anchor|Glitch Tiles|}}
| [[File:TILE Glitch Icon Blank.png|120x120px|center|class=glitch-tile-icon]]
|
Will stay active above some of the other tiles like water.
|
* Inflicts cats with {{st|Scrambled|#=1}}.
* Inflict non-cats with {{St|Confusion}}.
* Can affect {{St|Flying}} units.
|}

== Notes ==
* ''Most'' tiles will not affect corpses.
** {{Bug|{{tile|Stalagmite}} visually damages corpses, but will not actually decrease {{stat|Corpse Health}}.}}
* Some tiles are considered "{{Anchor|liquids}}" for enemy AI and various ability interactions (such as {{en|Fetus}}):
# Water (all types)
# Creep
# Lava
# Tar
# Toxic Waste
